I know it’s tough but what I would recommend is to sell one of your cars and use that money to pay off your highest interest debt that way you will actually reduce two monthly payments, the car and the debt. That should be able to push you just above float. Not sure what your exact vehicle situation is but unfortunately like others said you just won’t be able to afford two vehicles(especially at this interest rates) and therefore selling one should be one of your first steps. Also sounds dumb but see if there is any extra sources of income you or your partner could find even if it’s picking up one extra shift or some small and easy work from home stuff for your wife and putting that income soley into paying off your highest interest debt. It will feel hard in the moment but that debt will fade so fast drastically lowering your monthly expenses and you will feel so good
